newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Sowa cites loan disposals, stocks for loss.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Sowa cites loan disposals, stocks for loss.

text.p: Tokyo Sowa Bank Ltd said on Friday that a downward revision in its earnings forecast announced earlier in the day was due to active disposal of problem loans and appraisal losses on shareholdings.
It said in a statement that its appraisal losses on shareholdings was estimated at 29.9 billion yen in 1996/97 and problem loan disposals stood at 22 billion yen.

The regional bank announced earlier on Friday that it had revised its forecast for parent current earnings for 1996/97 to a loss of 41.90 billion yen from a previous forecast of a two billion yen profit, and compared with a loss of 52.10 billion yen in 1995/96.
Despite posting special profits on real estate sales in 1996/97, it is being forced to post parent current and net losses for the second straight year, it said.
Tokyo Sowa, a regional bank operating in the Tokyo metropolitan area, is scheduled to announce its 1996/97 business reults in late May.
